text: Way too expensive for what it does. $89 per seat per month and they charge extra for the API. Cancelled after the renewal price jumped.
The app is painfully slow. Loading a contact list takes 20 seconds and it freezes constantly. I wish it had a faster search.
Pricing is confusing with hidden fees. We were billed for seats we never used. Support ignored my ticket for two weeks.
No way to export contacts to CSV. Lacks a mobile app too. Honestly useless for field sales.
It crashes whenever I import more than 500 rows. Very laggy dashboard. Need an offline mode, my connection is bad on site.
Customer service never replied. Data loss after sync error, lost a week of notes. Terrible.
Missing integration with Gmail and no webhook support. Doesn't support custom fields on the free plan.
Overpriced subscription, $120/month for a CRM with a clunky and confusing interface. The paywall for reports is ridiculous.
Too complicated to set up. Hard to find anything. I wish it had a simple lead clipper for the browser.
Slow, buggy and expensive. Pages time out and the sync keeps breaking.
Lacks a browser extension to save leads from LinkedIn. We had to copy and paste everything by hand.
Can't bulk edit contacts. No way to merge duplicates. Support told me to upgrade to the $200 plan.
Love the pipeline view! Great product.
Solid tool, the reports are helpful.
Okay overall, a bit slow at times but fine.
The mobile app is missing half the features and it is very slow on Android. Needs an offline mode.
Billing nightmare. Charged twice and refund took a month. Way too expensive anyway.
Doesn't support webhook sync and no API on the cheap plan. Cannot connect to Zapier.
Search is sluggish and the UI lags with a few thousand contacts. Wish it had keyboard shortcuts.
I hate the pricing. Per seat cost is insane for a small team of 3. Cheaper alternatives exist.
Buggy export, the CSV is broken and drops columns. Support was unhelpful.
Needs a lightweight option. It is bloated, slow to load, and costs $99 a month just to store contacts.
No offline access. When the wifi drops I lose what I typed. Missing autosave.
Terrible customer support, no response in 10 days. The app freezes when I attach files.
